note: Festivals the city keeps, and when. Each `on` is one year's run: `start` and `end` bound the season, `peak` is the night it builds to, and the festival joins the Festivals tab in Events (and the shelf on Today) `lead` days before `start` — 45, so there is time to book. A record joins with `"festival": "<id>"`; `match` words pull in the city feed's own listings by title. Read by festivalTab and festivalShelf in js/app.js. Dates that move (Diwali, Lunar New Year) are entered per year — check them each autumn.

items.name: Navratri
items.line: Nine nights of garba and dandiya: Gujarati circles in the colony parks, ticketed raas nights on the big grounds, and kuttu-atta thalis for the fasting.

items.name: Durga Puja
items.line: CR Park turns into Kolkata for five days: pandal-hopping after dark, dhunuchi dancing, and kosha mangsho and mishti doi from the stalls.

items.name: Dussehra
items.line: Ten nights of Ramlila on the Red Fort grounds, ending with Ravan, Kumbhkaran and Meghnad burning in front of a crowd of thousands.

items.name: Halloween
items.line: Costume nights at Hauz Khas and Connaught Place.

items.name: Diwali
items.line: The city's biggest week: Chandni Chowk's lights and Kinari Bazaar tinsel, mithai queues, diya stalls at Dilli Haat and card parties in every colony.
items.imageSubject: A rangoli lit with diyas for Diwali

items.name: Chhath
items.line: Purvanchali families wade into the Yamuna ghats at sunset and again at dawn, with offerings to the sun in bamboo baskets.

items.name: Gurpurab
items.line: Guru Nanak's birthday: Bangla Sahib and Sis Ganj lit up, nagar kirtan processions through the old city, and langar for anyone who comes.

items.name: Christmas
items.line: Khan Market lit up, carols at Sacred Heart and plum cake at the old bakeries.

items.name: New Year's Eve
items.line: Parties from Aerocity to Hauz Khas. Book ahead, and plan the ride home.

items.name: Lohri
items.line: Bonfires in the Punjabi colonies on the coldest week of winter, with rewri, gajak, peanuts and popcorn thrown into the flames.

items.name: Republic Day
items.line: The parade down Kartavya Path, then Beating Retreat at Vijay Chowk three days later as the camels stand on the skyline.
